headlines.description: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points, Atlanta opened the fourth quarter with an 18-0 run, and the Hawks beat the Detroit Pistons 107-97 on Sunday as Cade Cunningham was held to a season-low five points.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexander-Walker has 27 points as Hawks roll to 107-97 win over Pistons in off game for Cunningham

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Miami Heat

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adebayo gets triple-double, Heat (without Giannis) top Thunder (without SGA) for 7th straight win
